name: Agency — motion edition
description: Agency template by Start Bootstrap, adapted with native motion, self-contained demo artwork and 1 page. Upstream source stays separate.
author: Start Bootstrap
usage: Extract the ZIP and open index.html. The runnable edition needs no package installation or CDN.

Original upstream HTML/CSS/scripts are in upstream/. The root pages use separate MigBits motion, navigation and original SVG artwork. Original stock photographs, fonts, favicons and icon libraries are not bundled.
Forms, purchases and external links are frontend demonstrations. Connect your own production backend and replace the demo content. Preserve LICENSE, BOOTSTRAP-LICENSE and MIGBITS-ADAPTATION-LICENSE.
Pause motion is available in every adapted page; OS reduced motion is respected. Render checks are not a full accessibility or production-readiness certification.
